assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 D Billions 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方／创作者：谁在运营该频道？是一个家庭吗？印度的。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别。
  7. 内容供应模式。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，D Billions 排名第 45 名，历史累计观看量约为 56B（560 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 D Billions 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
D Billions is a Kyrgyz children's entertainment brand and YouTube empire, not Indian. Below is a structured dossier with all requested fields and source URLs.

(1) STABLE CHANNEL ID AND CANONICAL URL

  • Channel ID: UCi3onjs7UU2Z64i3RrVci-Q
  • Primary canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@dbillions
  • Alternate legacy/canonical forms: https://www.youtube.com/c/DBillions and https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCi3onjs7UU2Z64i3RrVci-Q
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D_Billions ; https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCi3onjs7UU2Z64i3RrVci-Q

(2) OPERATOR/CREATORS

  • Founder and producer: Ernist Umetaliev, a Kyrgyz sound engineer/music producer who owns Eka Records. He is the son of Gulmira Esengulova, director of the Ak Shoola National Children's Choir.
  • Co-founder/owner: Cholponai Kenzhekulova (Ernist's wife). Together they founded AWA Productions.
  • Legal entity: LTD AWA Company (per dbillions.com footer).
  • Performers playing the four characters: Asko Anarkulov (Cha-Cha), Janybek "Johnny" Jenishbekov (Boom-Boom), Baktybek Ismanaliyev (Chicky), Angelina Ee (Lya-Lya; previously Darina Vekua).
  • The team is Kyrgyz, not Indian. The group was recognized by Kyrgyzstan's Cabinet of Ministers in May 2023.
    Sources: https://dbillions.com/about ; https://finance.yahoo.com/news/d-billions-creating-youtube-kids-140036262.html ; https://thediplomat.com/2023/06/could-chicky-cha-cha-boom-boom-become-kyrgyzstans-soft-power-motto/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D_Billions

(3) CHANNEL CREATION DATE AND EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD

  • Channel created: July 27, 2019.
  • Earliest upload (still public): "Left! Right! | D Billions Kids Songs" — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7UrknYa7Dwc, uploaded August 8, 2019. It has accumulated over 90 million views.
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D_Billions ; https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/D_Billions ; https://globalvoices.org/2023/06/09/kyrgyzstans-youtube-sensation-d-billions-kicks-off-its-global-concert-tour/

(4) OPERATING LOCATION AND DISPLAYED COUNTRY

  • Operating location: Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan (Kyrgyz Republic), Central Asia.
  • Displayed country on YouTube: Kyrgyzstan (all sources consistently place the operation in Kyrgyzstan; Bloomberg states "home base in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan").
    Sources: https://finance.yahoo.com/news/d-billions-creating-youtube-kids-140036262.html ; https://thediplomat.com/2023/06/could-chicky-cha-cha-boom-boom-become-kyrgyzstans-soft-power-motto/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D_Billions

(5) LANGUAGES

  • Primary language: English (main channel).
  • Additional content in 11 localized channels: Spanish, Russian, Indonesian, Kyrgyz, Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, Arabic, French, Japanese, and Chinese — totaling 12 languages.
    Sources: https://dbillions.com/ ; https://dbillions.com/about ; https://thediplomat.com/2023/06/could-chicky-cha-cha-boom-boom-become-kyrgyzstans-soft-power-motto/ ; https://globalvoices.org/2023/06/09/kyrgyzstans-youtube-sensation-d-billions-kicks-off-its-global-concert-tour/

(6) PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY

  • Children's educational entertainment, musical comedy, nursery rhymes/sing-along songs for preschool audiences. Content teaches counting, colors, nutrition, animal care, safety, and multilingual vocabulary.
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D_Billions ; https://dbillions.com/about

(7) CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL

  • Fully in-house production: over 80 staff covering original music composition, sound engineering, illustration, 2D/3D animation, and choreography, all based in Kyrgyzstan.
  • Over 500 original musical pieces produced since 2019 (as of June 2024); 4 videos with 1B+ views, 60 with 100M+ views.
  • Multi-channel localization model: original English content is adapted into 11 additional language channels by the same in-house team.
  • Revenue streams extend beyond YouTube into live tours (concerts of 60,000+ in Bishkek), toys, films, mobile games, and merchandise.
    Sources: https://dbillions.com/about ; https://dbillions.com/ ; https://finance.yahoo.com/news/d-billions-creating-youtube-kids-140036262.html ; https://thediplomat.com/2023/06/could-chicky-cha-cha-boom-boom-become-kyrgyzstans-soft-power-motto/

(8) REPRESENTATIVE SERIES

  • Standalone hit songs: "Yummy Fruits & Vegetables" (3.5B+ views), "Clap, Clap, Cha Cha Cha!" (2.7B+ views), "My Name Is Chicky" (viral TikTok trend; featured in Eurovision 2022 promo and Just Dance 2024), "123 Song," "Shake, shake your body!"
  • Format series: Mega Compilations, Baby DB (baby versions of characters), DB Heroes, VavaLoo (separate channel), DB VLOG.
  • Animated storytelling in 2D/3D formats built around the four core characters (Cha-Cha, Boom-Boom, Chicky, Lya-Lya).
    Sources: https://dbillions.com/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D_Billions ; https://thediplomat.com/2023/06/could-chicky-cha-cha-boom-boom-become-kyrgyzstans-soft-power-motto/
